svg.text: A bought stainless spring clip with a strap loop, about 22 wide

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 40 long, base leaf about 1 mm thick.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If its base leaf has no holes, drill two 2.2 mm holes 12 apart

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across the leaf, 3 mm from its top end; open the clip and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clamp the leaf on wood to drill; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: base leaf flat on the rear face, centred, top end 2 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: below the badge's top edge; two M2 x 8 screws into the bosses.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the screw heads sit flat and the clip still closes.
